h: Handy for the station and the shops
p: Arundel Street sits right in the middle of Portsmouth's main shopping area, close to Commercial Road and Cascades, and only a few minutes' walk from Portsmouth & Southsea station. If you're coming in by train for the day, it's barely out of your way.

Most visitors to Portsmouth head for the waterfront. The Historic Dockyard, home to HMS Victory, the Mary Rose and HMS Warrior, is down at The Hard, and Gunwharf Quays with the Spinnaker Tower is right next door. For proper seaside amusements with the kids, Clarence Pier on the Southsea seafront is the place.
Regency on Arundel Street is 18+, so bring ID if you're likely to be asked.
